kind: deployment (0 alpha trials; rule pre-set as in H1-H3)
question: H2 / H3 chose the account risk on the hourly-stop path. Which risk is best on the 5-minute path with the hybrid stop (STOP-1) and the planning levels that include the live fill delay (EX-1 / EX-2)?
method: scripts/v99/stop1_design functions (same 5-minute paths, same firm rule engine, 400 paths, one account, 3 challenge budget, 2 years); risk grid 1.0 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2.0; hybrid stop at 2.5% / 3.75% of the account for every risk
rule: risk* = highest mean 2-year net at the planning level among risks with P(net loss) <= 0.20; if a LOWER risk is within 5% of that mean at the planning level, or beats it at the lower Sharpe level, the lower risk is taken (robust choice, as H3)
